title: Incremental exposure orchestrator with Bayesian early-stop and shadow inspection
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an experiment orchestration framework for model version comparisons that supports incremental exposure, shadow inspection, and Bayesian early-stop rules. This work targets product teams that require safe canaries and A/B tests for model upgrades across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. The feature should integrate with Console experiment UI, Runtime routing policies, and Optimize suggestions so teams can define experiments, enforce exposure budgets, and reliably auto-rollback when statistical or signal-driven regressions are observed.
acceptance_criteria: Console: create/edit experiment with: traffic schedule, max exposure, cohort segmentation, shadow-enabled toggle, and target metrics
Runtime: routing layer enforces exposure limits and applies shadow-routing without user-visible latency impact
Statistical engine: supports sequential Bayesian stopping and optional frequentist checks (SPRT/EWMA), configurable priors, and false-discovery control
Auto-rollback: configurable triggers combining statistical alarm + signal thresholds (latency/error-rate/quality delta) and a safe rollback path
Observability: per-variant dashboards (latency, token cost, quality metrics), cohort breakdown, and drift indicators exported to Console and alerting channels
Shadow inspection: captured shadow requests/outputs stored to customer sandbox + anonymized sample stored to S3 for offline evaluation
E2E tests: canary -> staged -> full rollout flow validated in staging with simulated traffic and circuit-breaker behaviors
Docs & runbook: public docs for experiment setup and an on-call runbook for rollback/investigation
notes: Design constraints: must keep endpoint latency SLOs intact (<=50ms tail for low-latency models). Shadow traffic must never impact production model outputs. Privacy: ensure PII scrubbing for persisted shadow samples. Trade-offs discussed: Bayesian sequential tests reduce sample size needed but require careful prior selection; provide both Bayesian and frequentist knobs.

implementation_summary: Phase 1: Control plane API + Console UI for experiment definitions, runtime gating for exposed traffic, and shadow toggle. Phase 2: Statistical engine (Bayesian sequential module) integrated with Console alerts and Optimize recommendations. Phase 3: Auto-rollback orchestration with playbook and runbook automation. Key infra pieces: shadow-forwarder service, per-variant metrics aggregation, and experiment-state persistence with TTL.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: incorrect priors lead to false rollbacks -> mitigation: default conservative priors and require dual-signal confirmation (statistical + quality delta) before automated rollback. Risk: shadow storage leaks PII -> mitigation: pre-persist scrubbing and allow customers to opt-out. Risk: runtime enforcement bug could over-route traffic -> mitigation: safety quota at LB layer that caps experiment exposure enforced by infra policy.
test_plan: Unit tests for control-plane validation, integration tests for routing enforcement with simulated load, offline evaluation of Bayesian stopping on historical A/B datasets, and chaos tests to ensure rollback path works when datastore or metrics pipeline are degraded. Add canary job in staging that runs a 1% exposure experiment daily.
